note: TRANSCRIBED FROM APPENDIX A.2 AND FROM NOWHERE ELSE, on the same terms as CORE-50K.json: a config record owns a value rather than restating one, and ADR-037 extended CI-06g's rule from counts to parameters for exactly that reason. THIS PLAN EXISTS BECAUSE CORE EOD DISABLES EVAL CONSISTENCY. Appendix A.1 carries `Eval consistency: disabled` at every size, so R-28, R-29 and R-30 have nothing to act on there and no Core EOD fixture can pin them. Appendix A.2 carries 3000bp, which is what makes GS-020, GS-023 and GS-024 expressible at all. The plan is named Merit Rapid and not Rapid Daily per ADR-013: the plan is fast relative to the lineup, it is not daily, and the name may not claim it is.
